title: It’s hell
content: I’m pretty sure the mall world dream is maybe our soul getting pulled into hell which later on affects our physical body being pulled into hell at least that was my fear when I was having dreams about malls. All the mall dreams started almost normal, although I did feel fear. I was on the third floor of the mall and then the next time I had the dream I was on the second floor. Eventually, I was in the basement and the mall was connected to a subway I think. when the mall world was trying to trick me, there were escalators going to different expensive northwest suburb type shops (I’m from Chicago). But I wanted to confront whatever was causing me fear so that escalator aspect only lasted one or two dreams. what was persistent was me going into the basement of the mall which doubled as a subway system and eventually as I kept insisting on confronting what was causing the mall dream Every time I had the dream after that, there would be a zombie apocalypse or some kind of disaster maybe a flood. And all the other people in the mall dream would run down into the basement to find a safe place to go in the subway system, but I didn’t wanna run anymore so I ran towards the zombies or the flood and that’s when the dream stopped happening and the reason that I got brave is because I knew that if I gave into the fear, the dream would never stop recurring or should I say nightmare. So confronting the source of the fear IN the mall apocalypse DREAM might have been what stopped the recurring dream but disclaimer I also decided to get a job as an AI engineer for the first time in 10 years since I graduated university around the time the dream stopped. By the way, I used to live in the old international consulate building in downtown Chicago, which was connected to the subway blue line, which is the main line to O’Hare airport. It’s like a private entry into the airport line right at the train crossing. I used to have to take that subway line to school all the time, and I hated it because there are sometimes people who throw Snickers bars into the tracks and little animals come out to take the snicker bar if you know what I mean and it feels like the snicker bar throwers are trying to spread hell. Anyway, if you don’t confront what everyone is running away from in your mall dream, you might end up living the thing that they’re running away from in real life.
